collection.title: Dacia Sandero 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Dacia Sandero 2021 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Fit arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Sandero which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
